# dsh-pylon-trae

> A **Trae LLM provider plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)**.
> Repository: <https://github.com/rumil

hz/dsh-pylon-trae>
> Package name: `dsh-pylon-trae` (this is the first plugin under the `dsh-pylon-`

lon-trae>
> Package name: `dsh-pylon-trae` (this is the first plugin under the `dsh-pylon-` prefix).
## English
### What it is

This plugin adds a **Trae** provider to DeepSeek Harness. After installing it and
restarting DSH, `S

ettings → Models` gains one **editable** `Trae` provider whose
model list is read from the Trae inst

allation already signed in on this machine
(Trae desktop app, or the Trae CLI).
It does **not** depend on, import, or patch `dsh-connect-trae`.
### How it works

1. It reads the credential file that the Trae desktop app or the Trae CLI already
wrote, and decrypt

s it locally with its own implementation.
2. It pulls the live model directory for the signed-in edi

tion (CN or
international) and decodes the streaming responses.
3. It serves an OpenAI-compatible en

dpoint (`/healthz`, `/v1/models`,
`/v1/chat/completions`) from a **fixed loopback port**. `/v1/model

s` advertises the
**conversation models only**: the directory also answers with Trae's own IDE workf

low
components (`title_generation`, `fast_apply`, the `custom_model_*` placeholders, the
`*_advisor`

/ `search_agent_*` aliases), and this plugin tells them apart by **fields**
rather than by a hand-w

ritten denylist. On the live CN directory that is
**47 chat + 32 internal = 79**, and `/healthz` nam

es the parts
(`models` / `chat` / `internal` / `total`).
4. It seeds one provider entry into the `ll

m-pi-ai` namespace, which is the
namespace the Models page renders an editor for — so you can add, r

emove and
test models from the UI.

**Trae's own data is read-only.** The plugin never writes to Trae's files; there
is an assertion in
the code that refuses to.
### Hard prerequisites — all four
| # | Requirement | If it is missing |
| 1 | **Trae is signed in on this machine** (desktop app is easiest; the CLI counts too) | The plugi

n starts but exposes no models and reports "no usable credential" |
| 2 | **Port 7864 is free** (CN
build; 7865 for the international build) | The loopback service cannot start, which means there is n

o channel at all |
| 3 | **`dsh-connect-trae` is not mounted in the profile** | Two Trae providers f

ight over the same route id (`trae` / `trae-global`) |
| 4 | **Windows** | The macOS / Linux code pa
ths exist but are **untested on real hardware** |

> Installing does **not** start or restart DSH. Quit DSH completely and reopen it.
> Reloading the w
indow is not enough.
### Install
Three routes are documented in `发布.md`. In short:

- **From this repository (GitHub source).** The install target is a pnpm GitHub
spec, `github:rumilh

z/dsh-pylon-trae`. Any DSH version that can add a plugin
from a GitHub source can install it this wa

y.
- **From the plugin market.** ⛔ **Not searchable yet.** An entry has been / will
be submitted to

the curated `awesome-dsh-plugin` catalog, but the market only
offers sources inside that catalog, so

this route works **only after that pull
request is merged**. See `发布.md`.
- **From a prebuilt tarba

ll.** `node tools/pack.mjs` produces
`dist/dsh-pylon-trae-<version>.tgz` plus a `.sha256` and a `.ma

nifest.txt`
checksum pair; `node install.mjs --from <tgz>` installs it offline.

Node **≥ 22.6** can run the `.ts` sources directly (type stripping), so there is
no build step.

**① 卡片这条通道依赖宿主的两件事，任一件变了卡片就整片 403。**

卡片的数据走宿主 web server 上本插件自己注册的路由（`/plugins/dsh-pylon-trae` 与 `/api/plugins/dsh-pylon-trae`），
而请求要过宿主自

己的栅栏 `connection.requestRejection`。桌面 app 的 UI 层只转发 `/api/*`，
